title: Analyzing the Evaluation of Cross-Lingual Knowledge Transfer in Multilingual Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing performance drops per class label (e.g., entailment vs. not-entailment in NLI, paraphrase vs. non-paraphrase in Paraphrase Identification) in across-language evaluation setups where word overlap is minimized, revealing the model's reliance on lexical overlap heuristics rather than true semantic understanding.

Calculating the average distance of shared question words in the context to the center of the answer span, and comparing the top 20% easiest and hardest QA instances to uncover the model's reliance on the concentration of shared words as a shortcut.
